author: Red Means Recording
description:
https://redmeansrecording.gumroad.com/l/HZCRFT

HAZECRAFT is 75 Move and Note compatible presets for the Drift synthesizer in Ableton Live 12. These sounds are done in the style of warm, retro, and lofi.

It features:

20 Basses
13 Pads
12 Leads
10 Arps
10 Keys
10 Polys

Each instrument features macro controls over:

LPF
Resonance
ADSR
HPF
Volume

This allows any sound to be turned into a softer (pad) or harder (keys, poly, lead, arp) version of itself right on the device.
